    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersSteward's roast drumsticks and grapesThyme butter drumsticks with cherry tomatoes, red grapes and crusty breadHow to make it8 chicken drumsticks40g butter, softened1 tsp dried thyme1 tsp salt250g cherry tomatoes250g red grapes1 loaf of crusty breadHeat the oven to 200°C. Rub the drumsticks with butter, thyme and salt.Roast until cooked through.Lay on a long board with the tomatoes, grapes and torn bread.Shire strawberries with honey creamSugared strawberries layered with honey whipped cream and shortbread crumbsHow to make it500g strawberries2 tbsp caster sugar1 lemon, juiced300ml thickened cream2 tbsp honey1 tsp vanilla extract8 butter shortbread biscuitsHalve the strawberries and toss with the sugar and lemon juice.Leave to go juicy.Whip the cream with the honey and vanilla to soft peaks.Crumble the shortbread roughly.Layer the strawberries, cream and shortbread in glasses and finish with a few whole berries.Minas Tirith garlic and herb flatbreadsThe white city on the mountainHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft yeasted flatbreads blistered in a smoking pan, brushed with garlic, parsley and thyme butter, with a bowl of whipped feta and honey.Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 250ml warm water and 2 tbsp olive oil and knead 8 minutes, then prove 1 hour.Divide into 8, roll thin and cook in a smoking dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered.Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and thyme and brush over.Blend 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, then drizzle with honey.MainsCoronation roast sirloin and potatoesBalsamic gravy, roast potatoes and honey-roasted carrots and parsnipsHow to make it1.5kg beef sirloin1kg potatoes, peeled and halved3 carrots, cut in batons3 parsnips, cut in batons2 tbsp honey3 tbsp olive oil200ml beef stock1 tsp balsamic vinegarsalt and pepper, to tasteHeat the oven to 200°C. Season the beef with salt and pepper and roast until 52°C in the middle.Rest the beef under foil.Roast the potatoes in oil.Toss the carrots and parsnips with honey and roast.Reduce the stock and balsamic with the pan juices for gravy.Green Dragon chicken and leek pieHome in the Shire at the endHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thigh, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, with buttery mash and minted peas.Brown 1kg diced chicken thighs in butter, then add 2 sliced leeks and 250g sliced mushrooms and cook 6 minutes.Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock and 150ml cream, add thyme and simmer 15 minutes until thick.Cool slightly, tip into a pie dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes.Serve with mash and peas tossed with butter and mint.SweetsSam's wedding cakeFruit and almond cake filled with apricot jam under white icingHow to make it175g butter, softened175g brown sugar3 eggs225g self-raising flour300g mixed dried fruit50g almonds, chopped3 tbsp apricot jam300g white icingHeat the oven to 160°C and line a cake tin.Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour, fruit and almonds.Bake until a skewer comes out clean.Cool, split and fill with apricot jam.Cover with white icing and add small flowers.DrinksGreen Dragon honey and ginger cupPale root beer over honey ginger syrup and lemon, served over iceHow to make it100g honey100ml water1 piece of fresh ginger, sliced1 lemon4 x 375ml bottles of alcohol-free pale root beer4 cups iceSimmer the honey, water and ginger, then cool and strain.Put some syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 pint glasses with ice.Pour in the ginger beer, tilting the glass.Stir once and add a lemon wheel.
